tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every measurement category available on UnitConvertLab, including standard SI/imperial categories and regional/historical unit categories, with unit counts.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: List all units in one measurement category. Use list_categories first to get a valid category id.

tools.name: search_units
tools.description: Fuzzy-search the unit index by name, symbol, alias or transliteration (e.g. 'sq ft', 'tola', 'kmh'). Returns matching units with their category ids.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a numeric value from one unit to another. Accepts unit names, symbols or aliases (e.g. 'km', 'miles', 'tola'). Both units must belong to the same measurement category.

tools.name: regional_unit_info
tools.description: Look up provenance for a regional or historical unit (e.g. tola, bigha, catty): its region, era, status, typical value range, known regional variants, usage notes and cited source.
